---
title: All Publsihed Data Reports
---


```{r all-data-reports}
#| results: 'asis'
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library("RefManageR")

# 1. Read the file text and the bib object
bibfiletext0 <- readLines(con = here::here("content/references.bib"))
bib <- RefManageR::ReadBib(here::here("content/references.bib"))

# 2. Parse out the specific section
sect_start <- grep(pattern = "%  * Survey Data Reports", x = bibfiletext0, fixed = TRUE)+2
sect_end <- grep(pattern = "% * Code books", x = bibfiletext0, fixed = TRUE)-1

sect_text <- bibfiletext0[sect_start:sect_end]

# 3. Extract the citation keys with safe regex
cite_lines <- grep(pattern = "@", x = sect_text, fixed = TRUE, value = TRUE)
sect_keys <- sub(".*\\{(.*?),.*", "\\1", cite_lines)
sect_keys <- trimws(sect_keys)

names0 <- c("AI" = "Aleutian Islands", 
            "GOA" = "Gulf of Alaska", 
            "EBS" = "Eastern and Northern Bering Sea", 
            "BSS" = "Bering Sea Slope", 
            "SAPcrab" = "Bering Sea Crab")

# 4. Loop through regions
for (i in seq_along(names0)) {
  
  region_code <- names(names0)[i]
  
  region_keys <- grep(pattern = region_code, x = sect_keys, fixed = TRUE, value = TRUE)
  # final_keys <- names(bib)[tolower(names(bib)) %in% tolower(region_keys)]
  
  # THE ULTIMATE FIX: Sort the text keys BEFORE subsetting the final object
  temp_bib <- bib[region_keys]
  years <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(temp_bib$year))
  years[is.na(years)] <- 9999  # Put "In prep" / missing years at top
  
  # Sort the text keys
  sorted_keys <- region_keys[order(years, decreasing = TRUE)]
  
  # Subset the object using the sorted text keys to preserve its R class
  cite0_sorted <- bib[sorted_keys]
  
  # Print region header
  cat(paste0('\n### ', unlist(names0[i]), '\n\n'))
  
  # Print directly with APA options (sorting = "none" ensures it doesn't try to resort and crash)
  print(cite0_sorted, .opts = list(style = "markdown", 
                                   bib.style = "authoryear", 
                                   sorting = "none",
                                   max.names = 99, 
                                   dashed = FALSE))
  
  # Print section separator
  cat('\n\n---\n\n')
}
```
